messages.content: I’ll submit a day-ahead solar hedge and a regulation-down-heavy reserve plan, with up-reserve awards reduced during solar hours to limit curtailment. I’ll reassess dispatch at every watch as prices, weather and reserve deployments change.

The first two days have settled at $101,714.47 net profit. All three DAM gates are covered. For the final day, I’ll manage reserve backing closely and preserve at least 125 MWh of terminal charge to avoid the buyback penalty.
